prompt:
Our Legal & Compliance team needs a machine-readable audit trail comparing two versions of our internal Software License Compliance Policy. The two document versions are somewhere in the contracts directory of the workspace.

The audit trail must ignore pure formatting noise (whitespace-only differences) and report only meaningful, substantive changes between the two policy versions.

Please produce a file called `audit_report.json` that contains:
1. A structured list of every individual change (each change should show what type it is, and what the content was before and after).
2. A summary with the exact count of added lines, deleted lines, modified lines, and total changes.
3. A reference to which document versions are being compared.

The compliance committee will use this report to understand exactly what changed between Policy v1 and Policy v2.
